text.p: Federated Investors said it launched two multi-sector fixed income funds.
The Federated Total Return Limited Duration Fund is managed within the duration range of the Merrill Lynch 1-3 Treasury Index, plus or minus six months.
The Federated Total Return Bond Fund is managed within the duration range of the Lehman Brothers Aggregate Bond Index, plus or minus 20 percent.
Both funds will be at least 85 percent invested in domestic investment-grade bonds, with up to 15 percent invested in high-yield, lower-rated or international debt securities.
Randall Bauer will managed the Duration fund, while Joseph Balestrino will manage Total Bond.
Both men have previously managed other Federated bond funds.
